articles.title: How to prepare for a job interview
articles.excerpt: Simple steps to make a strong first impression and speak with confidence.
articles.body: Good preparation is not about memorizing perfect answers. Read the job description, learn what the company does, and prepare two or three examples that show how you solve problems. Bring thoughtful questions and give yourself time to arrive calmly. Most importantly, be honest about what you know and what you are ready to learn.

articles.title: How to spot a safe job opportunity
articles.excerpt: Know what to check before sharing personal information or accepting an offer.
articles.body: A legitimate opportunity should clearly name the employer, job responsibilities, location, and contact person. Be careful when someone asks for money, your account password, or original identity documents. When in doubt, contact LY Haw HR Solution through the official links on this website before taking the next step.

articles.title: Write a CV employers can understand quickly
articles.excerpt: A clear CV helps your experience speak for itself in the first review.
articles.body: Start with the experience most relevant to the role. Use short bullet points that describe the result of your work, not only the task. Keep dates and job titles consistent, check your contact details, and make sure the document is easy to read on a phone.
